verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a first-party Templates feature that prefills properties and blocks in objects, which covers reusable templates for kinds of notes. Nothing in the evidence shows template variables such as date or title, or how templates are applied to recurring note types like daily notes. Missing for 10: documented template variables (date/title placeholders), evidence of applying or defaulting templates per object type or recurring note, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can define reusable templates (with variables like date and title) and apply them when creating recurring kinds of notes

citations.quote: Templates allow you to prefill the content of an object- you can prefill properties and blocks in your objects.
